name: Jolene
description: Sweet and shy, Jolene needs a patient, calm home where she can build confidence at her own pace. Good with kids and dogs; likely okay with cats.

name: Vex
description: A super-social little guy who loves making friends! Vex is ready to bring plenty of puppy personality to his forever home.

name: Calypso
description: A super-social sweetheart who loves people and other dogs. Calypso is crate trained and housebroken, and ready for a family of her own.

name: Cheeto
description: A little shy at first, Cheeto warms up with time. He is good with people and dogs, housebroken and crate trained. He needs a home without small animals.
